summary: 現HEAD 0c4b1ac20351d18539e5bef2f6b5378a4c8ea839 で、Task-bound repo-control proof は exact path coverage と typed dependency connectivity に限定され、Story atomic metadata・全lane reviewer ownership・current-HEAD verification authorityを迂回できない。legacy/no-Task/config-only/strict-target経路もfail-closedまたは既存互換として実装・focused test・E2Eで確認でき、architecture_boundary、regression_guard、path_surface_coverageを満たす。ADR追加は不要。
inspection_summary: risk_surfaces=Story/Architecture/Spec authority; typed Task schema and exact repository-relative path coverage; directed authored dependency data and undirected release-boundary connectivity; scope signal and split-plan serialization; atomic reviewer/verification authority; Gate DAG split-resolution; no-Task/config-only/legacy/strict-target compatibility; current-HEAD verification provenance. 指定11入力、review request、verification evidence、実装call path、focused unit/CLI/E2E、origin/main差分とclean HEADをread-onlyで確認した。
inspection_evidence: node --test test/e2e/story-vibepro-task-atomic-repo-control-contract-main.spec.ts => 1 pass, 0 fail; outer E2E invokes and asserts inner TAR CLI contract markers
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD; git status --short --branch; git rev-parse HEAD => clean branch, diff check pass, exact strict HEAD
judgment_delta: Prior concern: Task-bound atomic scope could omit verification authority -> Final: resolved. buildPrSplitPlan passes reviewer ownership and verification evidence into evaluateAtomicScopeDeclaration; current verification is filtered by dynamically resolved command.binding.status=current, and Gate DAG routes through split_resolution before pr_body_contract. Existing atomic-scope E2E passes on strict HEAD.

Initial concern: the new Story E2E exposes only one outer test and could be shallow -> Final: not shallow. The outer E2E runs the six public CLI acceptance paths and asserts the TAR contract markers/pass count; focused CLI rerun passed 7 relevant positive/negative/compatibility cases.

Initial concern: typed Task activation could regress legacy/no-Task/config-only/strict-target behavior -> Final: preserved. Legacy untyped Tasks load but remain ineligible, malformed/partial typed Tasks fail with repair guidance, no-Task independent repo-control remains unsafe, config-only exception remains compatible, and strict target rejection remains active.

Initial concern: dependency-direction or path normalization could silently broaden authority -> Final: bounded. Authored directed edges are preserved as proof while only release-boundary membership uses undirected reachability; exact repository-relative paths reject basenames, traversal, backslashes, globs, and uncovered changed paths.

Initial concern: architecture change may require ADR -> Final: no ADR required because the change is a bounded, local, reversible PR adjudication policy with explicit compatibility/rollback and no new external irreversible protocol, cloud authority, merge/deploy authority, or secret boundary.
